title: One column, one coin
hook: A uniform choice of column can still produce unequal outcome frequencies.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Uniform hash/draw assumptions; probability and weighted ranks as stated.
doesNotKnow: Sample a fixed categorical distribution using an alias table with a column and threshold choice.

misconception: Weighted sampling must scan a cumulative probability list on every draw.
objective: Sample a fixed categorical distribution using an alias table with a column and threshold choice.

claims.text: Each column has equal selection probability, but splits its area between itself and an alias. Comparing the supplied coin with the computed threshold chooses which part was sampled; outcomes need not share equal probabilities.
